card.name: "the" after decrease, before anticoagulant effect
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after a verb like decrease, lower or affect, in warfarin or anticoagulant interaction text, just before "anticoagulant effect" or similar. Also weaker on words like impaired or decreased in the same lowering sense.

modes.label: The after lowering verb
modes.description: "the" following decrease, lower or affect in a warfarin or anticoagulant interaction statement.
modes.example: MERCAPTOPURINE may decrease<< the>> anticoagulant effect. Monitor IN

modes.label: Impaired or decreased as a lowering word
modes.description: Words such as impaired or decreased that introduce a reduced function or lab value.
modes.example: Risk of<< decreased>> INR of prothrombin time

card.plain: It marks the spot after a drug is said to reduce something, where the next words name the blood-thinning effect.
